current-operational-taxonomy.label: Operational baseline - current tracked contract
current-operational-taxonomy.description: The active tracked JLPT kanji contract used by current deck tooling.
current-operational-taxonomy.notes: This is an input for comparison, not final source authority, and is not counted as an independent external source.

japanese-published-study-material.label: Tier 1 - Japanese-published study material
japanese-published-study-material.description: Japanese-published JLPT preparation materials or manually reviewed consensus from those materials.
japanese-published-study-material.notes: Required for passing source confidence. Do not copy copyrighted lists; record reviewed level judgments and permitted citations only.

community-legacy-jlpt.label: Tier 2 - Legacy/community JLPT list
community-legacy-jlpt.description: Community-maintained JLPT lists with legacy or observed-test basis.
community-legacy-jlpt.notes: Useful for triangulation, never sufficient alone.

community-jlpt-study.label: Tier 2 - Community JLPT study list
community-jlpt-study.notes: Useful as one independent signal after license and extraction review.

dictionary-learning-platform.label: Tier 3 - Dictionary or learning platform
dictionary-learning-platform.description: Dictionary or learning-platform metadata that assigns or tags kanji by JLPT level.
dictionary-learning-platform.notes: Use as supporting evidence after source terms are reviewed.

frequency-and-jlpt-platform.label: Tier 3 - Frequency and JLPT platform
frequency-and-jlpt-platform.description: Corpus/frequency-oriented metadata that may include JLPT tags.
frequency-and-jlpt-platform.notes: Frequency is a sanity signal, not an automatic JLPT level assignment.

learning-platform.label: Tier 3 - Learning platform
learning-platform.description: Structured learning-platform metadata that may include JLPT tags or comparable level signals.
learning-platform.notes: Use only after license and API/export terms are reviewed.

official-japanese-background.label: Background - Official Japanese metadata
official-japanese-background.description: Official Japanese metadata such as Joyo status or school grade.
official-japanese-background.notes: Useful for sanity checks but not a direct JLPT assignment.

official-jlpt-sample-evidence.label: Tier 1 - Official JLPT sample occurrence evidence
official-jlpt-sample-evidence.description: Positive kanji occurrence evidence from official JLPT sample questions or workbooks.
official-jlpt-sample-evidence.notes: Use only as occurrence evidence with citations; do not copy prompt text or convert occurrence into broad level-list truth.

operational_current_contract.label: Operational comparator - current tracked contract
operational_current_contract.description: The active repository taxonomy used for current deck tooling. It is compared against source consensus but does not vote in consensus.

pre_2010_direct_jlpt.label: Direct pre-2010 JLPT list lineage
pre_2010_direct_jlpt.description: Evidence derived from the old four-level JLPT lists where old 4 maps to N5, old 3 maps to N4, and old 1 maps to N1.
pre_2010_direct_jlpt.notes: This lineage is valuable for N5, N4, and N1, but multiple sources in this lineage do not by themselves prove independent modern JLPT consensus.

post_2010_estimated_split.label: Estimated post-2010 N2/N3 split lineage
post_2010_estimated_split.description: Evidence that estimates how old JLPT level 2 material splits across modern N2 and N3.
post_2010_estimated_split.notes: This lineage must be visibly labeled as estimated and cannot settle N2/N3 placement without other governed evidence.

japanese_published_textbook_review.label: Japanese-published textbook review lineage
japanese_published_textbook_review.description: Manual level judgments from Japanese-published JLPT study materials recorded without copying copyrighted lists.

community_jlpt_study_list.label: Independent community JLPT study list lineage
community_jlpt_study_list.description: Learner-facing JLPT study lists whose extraction, license, and independence have been reviewed.

dictionary_or_learning_platform.label: Dictionary or learning-platform JLPT metadata lineage
dictionary_or_learning_platform.description: Dictionary or platform metadata that assigns or tags kanji by JLPT level after license and extraction review.

frequency_sanity_signal.label: Frequency sanity-check lineage
frequency_sanity_signal.description: Frequency or corpus-oriented signals used to sanity-check level placement, not to assign JLPT levels by themselves.

official_japanese_background.label: Official Japanese background metadata lineage
official_japanese_background.description: Official Japanese background metadata such as Joyo status or school grade. It does not vote directly as JLPT level evidence.

official_jlpt_sample_occurrence.label: Official JLPT sample occurrence lineage
official_jlpt_sample_occurrence.description: Positive occurrence evidence from official JLPT sample material. It can support confidence after a separate occurrence model exists, but it is not a copied JLPT kanji list.

high_confidence.releaseMeaning: Consensus is source-backed, includes the required Japanese-published evidence, and meets the high agreement threshold.

standard_confidence.releaseMeaning: Consensus is source-backed and meets the standard agreement threshold, but not the high threshold.

disputed.releaseMeaning: Voting source groups do not produce a single consensus level.

weak_evidence.releaseMeaning: Some evidence exists, but independence, Japanese-published evidence, or agreement is insufficient.

unknown.releaseMeaning: No reviewed active voting source assignment exists for this kanji.

direct_legacy_mapping.label: direct legacy mapping
direct_legacy_mapping.description: At least one reviewed active voting source comes from the pre-2010 direct JLPT lineage, useful for N5, N4, and N1 but not enough by itself for modern source confidence.

estimated_split_evidence.label: estimated split evidence
estimated_split_evidence.description: At least one reviewed active voting source comes from a post-2010 N2/N3 estimate and must not silently settle placement by itself.

textbook_agreement.label: textbook agreement
textbook_agreement.description: Two or more active Japanese-published textbook lanes agree on the same exact level.

range_evidence_present.label: range evidence present
range_evidence_present.description: At least one source preserves an ambiguous level range such as N2/N3 without converting it into a fake exact vote.

range_evidence_only.label: range evidence only
range_evidence_only.description: Reviewed evidence exists only as a range and cannot produce exact placement consensus.

disputed_source_votes.label: disputed source votes
disputed_source_votes.description: Active voting sources tie or conflict in a way that prevents a single source consensus level.

weak_independence_or_missing_japanese_so.label: weak evidence gap
weak_independence_or_missing_japanese_so.description: Evidence exists, but it does not yet satisfy source independence, independent lineage, Japanese-published source, or agreement requirements.

unknown_no_reviewed_external_evidence.label: unknown source evidence
unknown_no_reviewed_external_evidence.description: No reviewed active external voting evidence is recorded for the kanji.

current_contract_mismatch.label: current contract mismatch
current_contract_mismatch.description: The current operational contract differs from computed external source consensus.

source_confidence_threshold_met.label: source confidence threshold met
source_confidence_threshold_met.description: The external voting evidence satisfies the governed confidence threshold.

current_operational_contract.name: Current JLPT kanji contract
current_operational_contract.notes: The active repository contract remains the current operational taxonomy only. It is recorded for comparison and deck tooling context, but it stores no source assignments, does not vote in source consensus, and must not be treated as source truth.
current_operational_contract.legalNotes: Repository-owned operational comparator. It is loaded from the tracked contract for comparison only; do not store assignment rows under this lane or let it vote as external source evidence.

tanos_legacy_direct.name: Tanos JLPT direct legacy resources
tanos_legacy_direct.notes: Useful as a direct legacy/community signal under Tanos Creative Commons BY sharing terms. Only the explicit N1, N4, and N5 base kanji lists are imported here. This shares the pre-2010 direct JLPT lineage, so it is valuable evidence but not a separate modern JLPT lineage by itself.
tanos_legacy_direct.legalNotes: Tanos permits sharing under Creative Commons BY terms. Store normalized reviewed assignments with attribution; keep raw downloaded source files ignored.

tanos_estimated_split.name: Tanos estimated N2/N3 split resources
tanos_estimated_split.notes: Active lane for Tanos N2/N3 estimated split evidence. It is normalized, labeled, reviewed separately from the direct N1/N4/N5 legacy lane, and lower-weight so it can inform disputes and candidates without silently settling placement by itself.
tanos_estimated_split.legalNotes: Permitted Tanos source lane, but estimated N2/N3 assignments must stay visibly labeled and lower-weight.

tanos_frequency_method_notes.name: Tanos N2/N3 estimate methodology notes
tanos_frequency_method_notes.notes: Non-voting methodology lane. Tanos states there is no official N3 vocabulary, kanji, or grammar list; N2 and N3 have to be estimated. Its N3 kanji notes say old JLPT kanji were mapped to new levels in the same way as the vocabulary list, where unclear N3 mappings were sorted by occurrence frequency in general Japanese using the Tanaka corpus. This lane explains estimated assignments; it must not vote as a separate source or move decks by itself.
tanos_frequency_method_notes.legalNotes: Stores a cited summary of methodology only. It must never vote or contain per-kanji assignments.

jlptsensei.name: JLPT Sensei kanji lists
jlptsensei.notes: Useful as one independent web-study signal after manual review. JLPT Sensei's terms reserve site content rights and restrict reproduction, duplication, copying, and redistribution, so this lane must not scrape, copy, or republish the site list. Record only minimal reviewed level judgments with per-level citations and evidence references.
jlptsensei.legalNotes: Restricted manual-review lane. Do not scrape, copy, or republish lists; store only reviewer level judgments with minimal citations/evidence refs.

kanshudo.name: Kanshudo usefulness/JLPT kanji data
kanshudo.notes: Use only after license and extraction terms are reviewed.
kanshudo.legalNotes: Do not import or count until terms grant a governed use path.

jpdb.name: jpdb kanji metadata
jpdb.notes: Frequency is a sanity signal, not an automatic JLPT level assignment.
jpdb.legalNotes: Frequency/JLPT platform metadata is reserved for sanity checks only unless a legal assignment-use path is reviewed.

wanikani.name: WaniKani kanji metadata
wanikani.notes: Use only after license and API/export terms are reviewed.
wanikani.legalNotes: Do not import or count platform data unless a governed use path is approved.

kanjidic2_legacy.name: KANJIDIC2 legacy JLPT metadata
kanjidic2_legacy.notes: Structured EDRDG source under CC BY-SA 4.0. KANJIDIC2 stores pre-2010 JLPT levels: old 4 maps to N5, old 3 maps to N4, old 1 maps to N1, and old 2 is retained only as N2/N3 range evidence. This shares the direct pre-2010 JLPT lineage with other old-list sources, so it is supporting evidence rather than an independent modern JLPT lineage by itself.
kanjidic2_legacy.legalNotes: EDRDG KANJIDIC2 is CC BY-SA 4.0. Store normalized reviewed legacy JLPT assignments with attribution; keep raw XML ignored.

shin_kanzen_master_kanji.name: Shin Kanzen Master kanji textbooks
shin_kanzen_master_kanji.notes: Individual textbook lane for reviewed level judgments from 3A Corporation's Shin Kanzen Master kanji books. Active for the pinned, manually reviewed N4 rows from the official free N4 teacher-tool workbook; additional local worksheet rows remain pending until source material supports exact source-level judgments. Do not copy copyrighted lists; record only permitted citations, evidence references, and reviewer judgments.
shin_kanzen_master_kanji.legalNotes: Copyrighted textbook lane. Do not copy lists or excerpts; store only manually reviewed level judgments with permitted citations/evidence refs.

nihongo_sou_matome_kanji.name: Nihongo Sou Matome kanji textbooks
nihongo_sou_matome_kanji.notes: Individual textbook lane for reviewed level judgments from ASK Publishing's Nihongo Sou Matome kanji books. Active rows come only from pinned manual-citation worksheets with permitted citations and evidence references. Do not copy copyrighted lists or move decks from this source-evidence row.
nihongo_sou_matome_kanji.legalNotes: Copyrighted textbook lane. Do not copy lists or excerpts; store only manually reviewed level judgments with permitted citations/evidence refs.

try_jlpt_textbook.name: TRY! JLPT textbooks
try_jlpt_textbook.notes: Individual textbook lane for reviewed level judgments from ASK Publishing's TRY! JLPT series. A 2026-05-08 source-access spike inspected the official series page, learning-item PDFs, product samples, and vocabulary-list surface; those public official materials expose grammar/can-do and vocabulary/occurrence evidence, not exact per-kanji JLPT assignment proof. Keep this lane blocked from assignment consensus unless actual source access provides exact per-kanji assignment evidence.
try_jlpt_textbook.legalNotes: Copyrighted textbook lane. Do not copy lists or excerpts; store only manually reviewed level judgments with permitted citations/evidence refs.

ask_hajimete_jlpt_kanji.name: ASK Hajimete JLPT kanji textbooks
ask_hajimete_jlpt_kanji.notes: Individual textbook lane for reviewed level judgments from ASK Publishing's Hajimete no Nihongo Noryoku Shiken kanji books. Official product pages currently identify dedicated N1, N2, and N3 kanji volumes; do not use this lane for N4/N5 rows unless exact permitted source access is separately verified. Active rows must come only from pinned manual-citation worksheets with permitted citations and evidence references.
ask_hajimete_jlpt_kanji.legalNotes: Copyrighted textbook lane. Do not copy lists or excerpts; store only manually reviewed level judgments with permitted citations/evidence refs.

japanese_textbook_consensus.name: Derived Japanese-published textbook consensus
japanese_textbook_consensus.notes: Derived non-voting summary computed from individual Japanese-published textbook lanes. It must not be manually populated or counted in external consensus in addition to the source lanes.
japanese_textbook_consensus.legalNotes: Repository-derived non-voting summary. It is computed from individual textbook lanes and must not duplicate their votes.

joyo_grade.name: Joyo kanji grade metadata
joyo_grade.notes: Official background metadata for sanity checks; school grade is not a JLPT assignment and must not vote directly in consensus.
joyo_grade.legalNotes: Official background metadata only. It can sanity-check kanji commonness or school grade but cannot vote as JLPT level evidence.

official_jlpt_sample_workbooks.name: Official JLPT sample questions and workbooks
official_jlpt_sample_workbooks.legalNotes: Use official material only as positive occurrence evidence with citation/page references. Do not copy prompt text, republish workbooks, or treat occurrence as a complete JLPT kanji list.
official_jlpt_sample_workbooks.notes: Active occurrence-only lane backed by a separate occurrence-evidence data model. Store only level, source PDF, section/page/question reference, and observed kanji. It must not become a per-kanji assignment vote in the current consensus engine.

bccwj_frequency.name: BCCWJ frequency lists
bccwj_frequency.legalNotes: Use only as frequency sanity evidence. It cannot assign JLPT levels or vote in consensus.
bccwj_frequency.notes: Planned frequency sanity-check lane for detecting implausible level placements after source confidence exists.

kanji_alive.name: Kanji Alive background metadata
kanji_alive.legalNotes: CC BY 4.0 learner metadata may support background sanity checks; it is not JLPT level proof.
kanji_alive.notes: Planned learner-background lane only. Do not count as JLPT assignment consensus.
